ops.oldText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement without IBM's consent to an affiliate or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. IBM will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without Customer's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Customer.

input.comment: [Playbook] We added our customary right to assign without consent to an affiliate or to a successor by merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and made the consent restriction reciprocal so IBM cannot assign to a Customer competitor. If helpful, we can accept a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice, with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.
input.summary: Add affiliate/asset-sale carve-out for Customer assignment and reciprocal consent restriction on IBM assignment.
